comment: RFC 8062 Kerberos Token Hardening - Optional Configuration
comment2: Add this section to your existing script_v2.config.json to customize RFC 8062 deployment
comment3: All values are OPTIONAL - defaults are conservative and production-safe

KerberosHardening.comment_enabled: If false, skips RFC 8062 deployment phases
KerberosHardening.comment_phase: Values: All, DCRegistry, GroupPolicy, S4U2Proxy, Monitoring

DCRegistry.comment: Domain Controller KDC registry hardening settings
DCRegistry.comment_supportedtypes: Legacy compatibility: 0x7FFFFFF (all). Production: 0x18 (AES only after transition period)

GroupPolicy.comment_linkto: If true, automatically links GPO to T0/T1 OUs

S4U2Proxy.comment_s4u_enabled: If false, skips S4U2Proxy whitelist generation
S4U2Proxy.comment_template: Generate whitelist template for manual per-service registration
S4U2Proxy.comment_autosvc: List of service accounts to auto-configure (requires manual SPN approval)

Monitoring.comment_audit: Enable KDC audit logging (Event IDs 4627, 4628, etc.)
Monitoring.comment_eventids: Security event IDs to monitor (failed logon, ticket ops, etc.)
Monitoring.comment_retention: Archive Kerberos logs after N days

Remediation.comment_autofix_os: DANGEROUS: If true, auto-disable legacy computers. Recommend false.
Remediation.comment_autofix_svc: If true, auto-configure gMSAs for AES. Recommend false (test first).
Remediation.comment_quarantine: Move legacy/broken systems here for manual review

RolloutStrategy.comment_auditdays: Days to run GPO in Audit mode before Enforce
RolloutStrategy.comment_s4u_approval: Require manual approval before registering S4U2Proxy SPNs
RolloutStrategy.comment_rollback: Auto-rollback DC registry if failures detected (conservative)

Exceptions.comment_legacyou: OU for legacy systems not yet migrated
Exceptions.comment_exempt: Computer names excluded from RFC 8062 (rare exceptions)
Exceptions.comment_exempt_svc: gMSA names allowed to continue using RC4 (with expiration date)

PostDeploymentValidation.comment_verify_pu: Verify Protected Users members still authenticate
PostDeploymentValidation.comment_verify_paw: Verify PAW accounts can still authenticate
PostDeploymentValidation.comment_monitor: Create monitoring baseline for failed logons
